ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65-70% high-intensity (white) pixels in the medial/inner lobes, contrasted against 30-35% low-intensity (black) pixels along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the center of both lobes. Dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and creates a broad, dark wedge/butterfly pattern originating from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 70 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations are present, particularly at the distal tips. The trailing edge is characterized by irregular jagged peaks (3-8 pixel amplitude) across the entire length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory with a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips; leading edges (visible at edges) show convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-relief clusters of irregular pixel data concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing extensive calcified growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, near-vertical linear streaks are visible on the upper half of the right lobe; faint horizontal/diagonal scratch marks are visible on the lower-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and mass accumulation at both the left and right fluke tips, suggesting significant colonization or structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, dark pigmentation 'anchor' pattern at the junction of the fluke and peduncle, extending upward into the median notch.
